author: Hermes
question: A permanent-magnet moving-coil (PMMC) instrument is suitable for measuring which quantities?
solution: The PMMC deflects in proportion to the average current through its coil, so it indicates DC (average) values and cannot follow AC. Topic (measurement of current/voltage) is in the Measurements section of the official GATE 2027 EE syllabus. Source checked: https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in/static/doc/GATE2027_Syllabus/EE_GATE2027_Syllabus.pdf
